_how: List real engine loops here and they appear as voices in the app on every device. Put the audio files (MP3/WAV/OGG) in this samples/ folder. Each voice needs one or more loops; several loops recorded at different RPMs crossfade for extra realism. 'rpm' is the engine speed the loop was recorded at — an estimate is fine (idle ~900, cruise ~3000, high ~5500).
_credits: race_*.wav: 'racing car engine sound loops' by domasx2, opengameart.org/content/racing-car-engine-sound-loops, CC0. classic_*.wav: 'Generic V8 Engine Sound' by DerMeehdrescher / Meehdrescher Studios, opengameart.org/content/generic-v8-engine-sound, CC-BY-SA 4.0. turbo_*.wav: 'Car Engine Loop 96kHz' by qubodup, opengameart.org/content/car-engine-loop-96khz-4s, CC-BY 3.0 (pitch variants baked). ev_*.wav / jet_whine.wav: 'Sci-Fi Sound Effects Library' by Little Robot Sound Factory (www.littlerobotsoundfactory.com), opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-sound-effects-library, CC-BY 3.0. All loops lightly processed (mono/resample/normalize + loop-seam crossfade).
